decoded.meaning: One label standing for a THREE-segment mount run - RFC-0027 amendment 6: a label covers a hop's whole local part, never one segment. The compacted run is /net/downlink/a (15 bytes packed: `03 net` + `08 downlink` + `01 a`), replaced by one 7-byte element; the residual /sensor/temp travels on as strings for the next hop to resolve.
decoded.note: Per-segment labelling was rejected: it would cost 21 bytes here instead of 7, keep the multi-element walk and per-element lookup the RFC exists to delete, and make the per-hop mint table scale with address depth - the one term a NARROW node cannot bound.
